THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
STUDIO
149
STUDY 173
White Mesh Graphic Tee & Ruffled Denim
Rights check
Source: 25056.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, wavy brown hair
and a white bow hair clip stands full-length against a
light gray backdrop. She wears a fitted white mesh
cap-sleeve top with a black bow graphic across the
chest. A medium wash denim midi skirt with a ruffled
asymmetric slit and a brown belt with a plush bear
charm sits at the waist. Black crossbody bag, patterned
socks, and chunky silver sneakers complete the look.
Her expression is calm, with one hand raised to her
hair. Soft, even studio light. Palette of white, faded
denim, and charcoal. Playful and feminine, in the style
of a Y2K lookbook.
Playful, feminine, Y2K
WORKING NOTES
- The bow graphic and ruffled denim slit are the key
details.
- Keep the bear charm as a playful accent.
Try this: Keep the bear charm as a playful accent.
